tool_args.rationale: The verified barrier-activated siphon law matches the pilot signatures. Fit its four parameters numerically to the five paid observations and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed s_grad span is 2.0, well above the stated 0.08 ambiguity threshold; five observations constrain the four-parameter mechanism.
These omit the observed sink-gradient dependence and are less consistent with the verified barrier and sink signatures.
The verified mechanism is an algebraic law at the target horizon, so a trajectory batch is not needed to identify it.
